parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass this value explicitly by using --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source to re-parse. This ID is unique within the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 待重新解析的数据源ID（租户内唯一）
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously wait for the re-parsing to complete. Default value: false, which indicates asynchronous queuing
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步等待重新解析完成；默认 false，异步入队
parameters.name: force_sync
